snippet.title: Kill The Music - Official Update Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Watch the new Kill The Music trailer for this rhythm action roguelite about defeating hordes of enemies with musical instruments. Kill The Music is available now on PC, and a new update is out now.
